$comment: The pipeline mirror of the app's Quran content registry.
Every entry here must have a matching entry in QuranEditions (domain) and, where it has
a bundled asset, in QuranContentAssets (data) — see docs/quran/content-registry.md.
The `id` is the join key across all three and is persisted on user devices, so it is
`contentVersion` gates re-seeding on upgrade. Bump it whenever the generated asset's
bytes change, or existing installs keep the old content forever.
Fetch an edition with:  python3 scripts/fetch_edition.py <id>
